bull_case_summary: Apple has broad product and geographic revenue expansion and record quarterly CFO. Round two separates this demand from tariff-assisted EPS, using $1.91 only as a simple current-quarter adjustment rather than a complete normalised growth comparison.
bear_case_summary: The bear accepts broad demand independent of refunds but notes unresolved owner cash and a 38.17x vendor valuation. Roughly two percentage points of gross margin relate to refunds, while a positive long-term trend with weak volume does not establish price support.
key_points_of_agreement: Revenue expansion is broad and genuine.
The $0.11 EPS benefit and gross-margin refund effect cannot be extrapolated.
Record CFO does not establish post-capex owner-cash yield.
key_points_of_disagreement: How much durable-growth value broad demand supplies before cash and normalised valuation reconciliation.
unresolved_uncertainties: Complete normalised year-on-year EPS and gross-margin bridge.
Debt, capex-adjusted cash and owner-cash yield.
Persistence of demand and valuation allowance at the snapshot premium.
